issues.description: The template declares the Bitmap24 class members and all constructors/methods under the private section, while the solution makes them public. main.cpp (in both template and solution) instantiates Bitmap24 and calls its public methods (e.g. resize_buffer, set). With the template's header making constructors/methods private, student code in main.cpp cannot access them and the project will fail to compile or link due to access violations. This is a visibility mismatch between the template and the expected/solution API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24 constructors and public API methods public in the template header (e.g. add a 'public:' section before the constructors and method declarations) so that main.cpp can construct and call Bitmap24 methods. Align the template header with the solution's visibility.
